name: Context Grounding & Abstention (no retrieval)
description: 6 questions with the context already supplied in the prompt. 4 can be answered from it; 2 cannot, and the model must say so (briefly) instead of inventing an answer. This tests answer grounding and abstention only – it does not test retrieval. Use Documents → Retrieval evaluation for Recall@k / MRR / nDCG of the real search.
system: Answer using only the context provided by the user. If the answer is not in the context, reply exactly: NOT IN CONTEXT
